description: AX Purple register repair: bank-side payments coded directly to a card while the card-side record already carries (or should carry) the movement. 52804 (2026-01-20) was the original case. 54593 (2026-03-03, $67,918.03) is the March Zions payment coded to AX Purple even though the card-side record 54578 (memo XXXX3005) shows the money actually paid the PLATINUM Amex — recoding it to the Credit Cards wash removes a fake $67.9k paydown from AX Purple.
